text_block_list.text:
One day, while waiting for the bus
to head to the shopping center—
(……*pssshh*)

A familiar face stepped off the bus.
It was Tucker Brine, who continues to explore ultimate training environments for Umamusume on uninhabited islands.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ngh... ahh!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... *pant* *pant*.
Is there a place... where I can rest...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Whew—— How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because I lived on an uninhabited island for so long, I've developed quite the motion sickness. Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Urk... Sorry for the trouble.
I should be heading off now... *whew* *pant*

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... No good.
I have an important meeting to get to.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
An idea for a new training facility――
I must make it a reality……

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You... don't need to follow me.
Please, don't stop me...!!
choice_data_list: I can't just leave you alone like this.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me go!
Do not rob me of my reason for living!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To create an environment where Umamusume can run
to their heart's content, unleashing their full potential...!
A dream environment like that!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Envisioning that ideal future is my mission... No――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's pure, absolute bliss!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: So you understand. Then I shall take my leave――
choice_data_list: I'm coming too... Hold onto my shoulder.
I'll come too... Hold onto my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What?!
You don't need to do anything of the sort――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...No, this is to seize the future.
I'll gladly take you up on that offer!!
With steady, resolute strides, Tucker Brine headed toward the meeting spot!
